_comment: Copied to <repo>/.agentkit.json by install.py. Every key is optional; scripts fall back to these defaults. Keys starting with _ are comments.

git._protected_commit: ask = agent must get your yes (default) | allow = no question | block = always refuse

notes._commit_tasks: false = notes/tasks/ (task notes + plans) is gitignored; decisions.md is committed

context._ignore_dirs: added to the built-in list (.git, node_modules, .venv, __pycache__, dist, build, wandb, mlruns, checkpoints …)
context._zone_max_files: rmap --zone prints at most this many zone files before '… +k more'

debug._min_similarity: dbg open/similar flag a past bug when keyword overlap (0-1) reaches this and >=2 words are shared

verify._comment: "auto" = detect · a command string = use it · null = skip this gate

guards._comment: Read by scripts/*.sh (install.py --guards). git.protected_branches, git.protected_commit, notes.dir and notes.base_branch above are used too. false switches a stage off; a missing tool fails its stage.
guards._ruff_cmd: command for the lint stage (split on spaces, no quoting): ruff check --quiet --output-format concise . ; ruff format --check .
guards._pytest_args: extra pytest arguments, e.g. --cov=src ; the coverage report is always --cov --cov-report=xml:<coverage_xml>
guards._fail_under: minimum coverage (%) of the lines changed against the base branch
guards._scope_ignore: globs the scope check never reports; null = built-in list (.agentkit/*, .agentkit.json, <notes.dir>/*, FAILURES.md, coverage files)
guards._merge_convention: free text shown in merge/push block messages, e.g. "merge commit named feat(<scope>): merge X"
guards._require_merge_commits: pre-push: every first-parent commit pushed to a protected branch must be a merge commit
